source_evidence: Player exact 'Yes we’d like to see the possibilities' authorizes obtaining prospective terms, not acquisition or spending. Crown title and household occupancy/use rights established by immediately prior D326 chunk. Precedent rules-estate-economy.md @c170a4e6800197e83820084b6350a87e5008d6c1 records existing conditional hereditary recovery grants and no paperwork-only blockers; world/politics/human-states.md @77333e27aa5946858c824352e71af893aa6e1b96 establishes recognized institutions/public rights; prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md @582dd9cfe965575548562916b606e5965813b522 fixes independent resident interests and no automatic title from clearance. At V's request to see acquisition possibilities, registrar consults the duty officer for Crown land dispositions in the same office; routine inquiry, no roll. Officer explains two newly adjudicated preliminary avenues, neither binding nor accepted: (1) as-is hereditary purchase of the Crown-held ruin and immediate disused grounds, indicative400gp subject to confirmation of the actual parcel boundary and competent Crown approval; no grant of the occupied dwelling, household landing/return-channel rights, public toll authority, ancient artifacts or neighboring land. Buyer bears restoration cost, no commitment to rebuild the entire structure. (2) conditional hereditary recovery grant with no purchase price, comparable in principle to existing Miregate/Reedbed recovery grants but separately negotiated: written conditional authority can be sought before fieldwork, title on actual agreed removal or securing of genuine hazards and confirmation of existing household access/use rights; no compulsory rebuilding of entire ruin, indefinite service, rent, bond or extra public office proposed, exact scope to be agreed before commitment. Neither route requires a speculative historical inheritance ruling; historic claim could be independently considered if actual evidence eventually establishes one, no bloodline/title proof now. Officer can prepare a specific conditional written proposal if V requests it, without charging or binding V. No survey fee, application, grant, reservation, deposit, deed, roll, expedition, acquisition or repair budget accepted. Newly established indicative terms are DM adjudication consistent with Crown land administration and established rights, not a discovered preexisting asking price or guaranteed approval. All party counters and current commitments unchanged. No exact acreage, restoration price, new enemy knowledge, forced expedition or further approval invented.
